 Prepend Breadcrumbs 
 Spun off from the cms_breadcrumbs project, prefer this name prepend_breadcrumbs instead, hense the move/change.

 Original ideas and development by Sam Tripp and elaborated with collaboration of Joseph.Olstad and Sam Tripp.

 Provides configuration options for leading breadcrumbs to maintain website hierarchy.

 Back to top 

 # Setup 
 Set leading breadcrumbs in two languages by navigating to Configuration > User Interface > Prepend Breadcrumbs. 

 # Reference Modules: 
 - [Easy Breadcrumb]( https://www.drupal.org/project/easy_breadcrumb )

- [Custom Breadcrumbs]( https://www.drupal.org/project/custom_breadcrumbs )

- [Menu Breadcrumb]( https://www.drupal.org/project/menu_breadcrumb )
